g.id: Quantities: pipe length by diameter, reservoir volume
Unit rates: OMR per metre, OMR per cubic metre
Add 10 percent preliminaries and 20 percent contingency
STEP 1. CAPEX: what it costs to build
0.5 percent of pipe and reservoir cost, 3 percent for chlorination
STEP 2. OPEX: what it costs to run, each year
1,000 OMR per month per pumping station
STEP 3. Income: what comes in, each year
Free tanker contracts no longer paid
STEP 4. Payback in months = CAPEX divided by income minus OPEX
STEP 6. Compare CAPEX, OPEX and payback, with a written list of pros and cons
THE GAPS: a rial in year 25 is counted as a rial today, cost is the only thing scored, and no assumption is ever tested
